messages:
Alice: CI smoke on main is red — hosted integration failing across auth + streaming tool-calls. Getting 401s and a couple of schema validation errors. Logs: https://internal.ci/logs/1755554321 :eyes:

ci-bot: pipeline hosted-integ-smoke failed (shard 12/24) — https://ci/1755554321

Bob: seeing `401 Unauthorized` from /v1/stream when calling with project token. Header shows `Authorization: Bearer <token>` but token introspection returns invalid after ~30s.

ci-bot: recent deploy: services/api v2.14.1 -> v2.15.0

Carol: Can someone rerun shard 12 and collect the full gateway logs? ping @dan for infra network checks.

Dan: Rerunning shard 12 now: `ci rerun --shard=12 --job=hosted-integ-smoke`

Eve: I reproduced locally against staging. Tool-call request body missing `tool_id` for a subset of requests; schema check fails with: `schema error: required property 'tool_id' missing`.

Eve: snippet:
```
POST /v1/toolcall
{ "name": "search", "args": {"q":"foo"} }
```
expected:
```
{ "tool_id": "search.v1", "name": "search", ... }
```

Frank: oncall here — bisecting. Initial bisect shows commit abc1234 altered toolcall envelope handling (PR #482). Could be a serialization fallback drop.

Frank: small diff: `if (!payload.tool_id) delete payload.metadata;` — suspect logic bug.

Alice: ok if that's the culprit we should hotfix to tolerate missing tool_id or reintroduce defaulting. I can open a quick patch.

Bob: opened PR #499: `hotfix/toolcall-envelope-fallback` — adds defensive default and preserves metadata. Starting CI.

ci-bot: rerun completed for shard12 — green. Overall smoke still red: shard7 streaming timed out.

Carol: shard7 looks like a separate infra transient — hitting streaming node timeouts in us-west2. Assigning to @dan and @eng-infra.

Dan: will recycle streaming pool in us-west2 and watch. command used: `infra pool-restart streaming-us-west2 --grace 30s`

Alice: thanks all. If you want to reproduce locally: `./scripts/run_hosted_smoke --shard 12 --log-level debug` and check `~/.redwood/logs/gateway.log` for `schema error` entries.

Bob: :thumbsup: monitoring CI, will update PR if we see regressions.

Carol: leaving this thread pinned to triage board. If anyone gets more flakes, drop logs here.
